entries.summary: The purpose of this meeting is to conduct a paper screen of candidate applications and select candidates to interview for possible appointment to the Instructional Quality Commission (IQC); and conduct a paper screen of candidate applications.

entries.title: 2026–27 FFVP Second Allocation Funding Results
entries.summary: On September 29, 2026, the CDE NSD awarded and posted the FFVP second allocation grant recipients and funding allocations for School Year 2026–27 on the CDE FFVP Funding Results web page. The FFVP second allocation is October 1, 2026–June 30, 2027.

entries.title: REQUIRED: 2026–27 FFVP Orientation Trainings
entries.summary: The CDE NSD requires all 2026–27 FFVP grantees to complete the mandatory FFVP Orientation Online Training Series before implementing the FFVP. The training series must be completed by no later than Wednesday, September 30, 2026, at 5 p.m. PST.

entries.title: Updates to Child Nutrition Program Standards
entries.summary: Two MBs SNP-08-2026, SFSP-02-2026 Updates to School Nutrition Program Standards and SNP-09-2026 Preschool Meal Pattern Requirements have been updated to reflect new federal meal pattern and nutrition standard requirement & flexibility options.

entries.title: USDA Foods Participation Election for SY 2027–28
entries.summary: Beginning October 1, 2026, and through December 15, 2026, SNP sponsors participating in the Food Distribution Program may submit a request to change the way they order and receive USDA Foods for School Year (SY) 2027–28.
